about: The copilot's evaluation set. `tools`: every tool the question needs (the rules router must call them; a model must call them or have them pre-fetched). `facts`: strings the answer must contain (case-insensitive). `held_out`: not used when tuning the router's keywords - its score is the honest one. Run: pytest tests/test_copilot_eval.py (router) and python -m services.api.eval_copilot --provider gemini|ollama (a model).
